title: Tensor compatibility of fixed derived scalar composition
statement: For arbitrary commutative rings A,B,C and unital maps φ:A→B, ψ:B→C, χ:A→C with χ=ψ∘φ, a scheme T, and arbitrary unbounded derived module sheaves U,V over A on its small etale site, let Fφ,Fψ,Fχ be the fixed scalar extensions and α:FφFψ≅Fχ their fixed adjoint compositor. Write δφ,δψ,δχ for the representative-normalized tensor comparisons [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations, def-weil-pbc-normalized-origin-scalar-comparisons, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-kun-derived-tensor]. Then α(U⊗V);δχ(U,V) equals Fψ(δφ(U,V));δψ(FφU,FφV);(αU⊗αV). No flatness, boundedness, constructibility, finite ring, or invertibility restriction on the ring maps is imposed.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat resolutions P,Q of U,V. Scalar extension preserves flatness and K-flatness for arbitrary ring maps. Compute the fixed left-adjoint compositor on these models using the normalized scalar model and its composition representative; uniqueness of adjunction mates identifies this representative with pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp.

proof.text: The ordinary tensorator sends (x⊗y)⊗b to (x⊗b)⊗(y⊗1). The ordinary compositor sends (x⊗b)⊗c to x⊗ψ(b)c. The two routes therefore agree on balanced pure tensors, both sending ((x⊗y)⊗b)⊗c to (x⊗ψ(b)c)⊗(y⊗1). The cochain composition tensor equation extends this through sheafification and signed totalization.

theorem scalarTensor_comp
    {A B C : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (χ : A →+* C) (hχ : χ = ψ.comp φ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (U V : DerivedCategoryModule A T) :
    (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj U).obj V) ≫
      (tensorIso χ T).hom.app (U, V) =
    (scalarExtension ψ T).map ((tensorIso φ T).hom.app (U, V)) ≫
      (tensorIso ψ T).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ T).obj U, (scalarExtension φ T).obj V) ≫
      (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) T)).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app U)
          ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app V))
